scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,cms,liff -c blue,red,green "npm run dev -w @getpoint/api" "npm run dev -w @getpoint/cms" "npm run dev -w @getpoint/liff"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @getpoint/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @getpoint/api -w @getpoint/cms -w @getpoint/liff
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
